water_attenuation — OPTICS watermedia op

• 資料種類:無 → table(僅由參數決定的運算子 —— 不接受影像或資料輸入)

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.water_attenuation(wavelength_um, water_type='pure', depth_m=None) -> 'dict'(要直接呼叫實作,import watermedia; watermedia.water_attenuation(wavelength_um, water_type='pure', depth_m=None) -> 'dict';從台帳取用則 opsoptics.get("water_attenuation"))

用法

水的吸收、散射與漫衰減係數,以及隨深度的穿透率 -> 字典。

> 以下的詳細說明為原文 —— 摘要與標題已翻譯。

water_type="pure": the absorption a is the integrating-cavity measurement of Pope & Fry (1997), 380-727.5 nm (minimum 0.00442 /m at 417.5 nm, 0.624 /m at 700 nm), interpolated linearly in wavelength; the scattering b is the pure-water law of Smith & Baker (1981), b = 0.00288 (lambda / 500 nm)^-4.32 per metre; the diffuse attenuation is approximated as Kd = a + b_b with b_b = b / 2 (a flat-sky approximation, flagged in kd_is_approximation). water_type="jerlov_I" ... "jerlov_9C" (IA, IB, II, III, 1C, 3C, 5C, 7C, 9C): the Jerlov (1976) optical water types, with a, b and Kd as assigned by Solonenko & Mobley (2015) at 400-700 nm in 25 nm steps, interpolated linearly; the paper gives no value for 3C above 650 nm and 5C above 575 nm, and asking for one is refused. The scattering of types I and IA is flagged by the authors as inconsistent with their own constants (b_suspect). An unknown type is refused with the list of known ones; so is a wavelength outside the table. c = a + b. depth_m (a scalar or a 1-D array of depths, m) adds transmittance = exp(-Kd z), the fraction of the downwelling light left at depth z (shape (nz, nw), or (nw,) for a scalar). The table has wavelength_um, a, b, c, kd (all per metre), transmittance, water_type, known_types, b_suspect and kd_is_approximation.

該族通用的輸入契約(fail-closed)

optics 的每個運算子都先檢驗輸入再計算(不讓任何東西無聲通過):

• 單位寫進參數名 —— _mm / _um / _deg / _mrad。把 mm 和 µm 弄混不會當掉,而是給出「看似合理卻是錯的答案」,所以用命名來防。這裡絕不從數值大小去猜單位。

• 字串一律 ValueError —— float('50') 會成功,於是未解析的設定值會被當成長度混進來(實測:thin_lens('50', '200') 曾回傳看似合理的 66.667 mm)。bool 也按 True == 1 的隱式提升拒絕。

• complex / masked array 一律 ValueError(僅接受實數槽位;拒絕無聲丟棄虛部或剝掉遮罩)。所有輸入中的 NaN/Inf 一律 ValueError。

• 逐項點名拒絕除零及其近親:焦距 0、曲率半徑 0、折射率 <= 0、全不透明光闌(全為 0,正規化變成 0/0)、總和 <= 0 的 PSF、S0 = 0 的 Stokes 向量、物體位於前焦點(像在無窮遠)。

• 只有兩個運算子會回傳非有限值,而且都寫進了契約:depth_of_field 在超焦距以外回傳 far_mm = inf(這正是超焦距的定義),gaussian_beam 在束腰處回傳 wavefront_radius_mm = inf(平面波前的曲率半徑)。兩者都同時回傳一個有限的夥伴(far_is_infinite / curvature_per_mm)。除此之外的無聲 NaN/Inf 都在內部檢出並 ValueError ——「float64 溢位了」和「答案是無窮大」是兩種不同的主張,不能拿後者的臉去交付前者。

• 尺寸上限:生成網格受 optics.MAX_GRID(4096)限制,傳入的場/PSF/光闌受 optics.MAX_FIELD_ELEMENTS(2^24),ABCD 元件序列受 optics.MAX_SYSTEM_ELEMENTS(1024),Zernike 受 MAX_ZERNIKE_TERMS(512)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_ORDER(40)/ MAX_ZERNIKE_BASIS(2^25)。以 fail-closed 堵住「小參數引發巨大內部配置」的路徑(實測:n_max=40 × 4096² 需要 108 GB)。

• 物理上不可能的狀態同樣拒絕:偏振度 > 1 的 Stokes 向量、負穿透率、負強度、n-|m| 為奇數等非法 Zernike 指標。
